issue_title: [Security] Final file permissions not set after atomic rename - only temp file has 0o600
summary: Added explicit os.chmod() call after os.replace() to ensure final file has 0o600 permissions on all filesystems
implementation_notes: While os.replace() preserves permissions on Linux, some filesystems may not behave consistently. Added explicit os.chmod() call to ensure the final file always has 0o600 (rw-------) permissions for security consistency.
